flavor: A massive, hollowed-out basalt pillar stands in the center of the chamber, its core glowing with a steady, rhythmic orange light. Heat shimmers off the soot-stained walls, and the air smells of ozone and scorched metal.
name: The Obsidian Crucible
reason: The room contains a cache of heat-tempered gear and precious metals, but the intense thermal currents make movement physically draining.
